architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Reusable UI components in src/components/. Neubrutalism CSS via Tailwind. React Router for navigation. Minimal state: local component state, no global store yet. Static mock data for screens. Responsive breakpoints match Stitch designs.

tickets.title: Build Jastip order form page (src/pages/JastipOrderForm.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch jastip_order_form_mobile to React. Form fields: item name, quantity, destination, notes, submit button. Neubrutalism styling: thick borders, bright colors, no rounded corners. Form validation: required fields, numeric quantity. Mock submission: log form data to console.
acceptance_criteria: Submit log form data to console

tickets.title: Build Jastip home screen page (src/pages/JastipHome.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch jastip_home_screen_mobile to React. Sections: hero banner, featured trips grid, search bar, category filters. Neubrutalism: bold typography, high-contrast colors, sharp edges. Static mock data for trips. Search/filter: client-side only, no API yet.

tickets.title: Build Jastip catalog pages (src/pages/JastipCatalogJepangTrip1.jsx, src/pages/JastipCatalogJepangTrip2.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch jastip_catalog_jepang_trip_1 and jastip_catalog_jepang_trip_2 to React. Two pages: trip catalog with item cards, pagination. Neubrutalism: card shadows, border accents, bold CTAs. Static mock data for items. Pagination: client-side only, no API yet.

tickets.title: Build ThirtySpace showcase pages (src/pages/ThirtySpaceTableShowcase.jsx, src/pages/ThirtySpaceSidebarShowcase.jsx, src/pages/ThirtySpaceLoaderShowcase.jsx, src/pages/ThirtySpaceBadgeShowcase.jsx, src/pages/ThirtySpaceButtonShowcase.jsx, src/pages/ThirtySpaceInputShowcase.jsx)
tickets.source_screen: thirtyspace_table_showcase, thirtyspace_sidebar_showcase, thirtyspace_loader_showcase, thirtyspace_badge_showcase, thirtyspace_button_showcase, thirtyspace_component_showcase_inputs
tickets.description: Convert Stitch component showcase screens to React. Reusable components: Table, Sidebar, Loader, Badge, Button, Input. Neubrutalism styling: consistent across components. Static mock data for tables. Components used in later pages.

tickets.title: Build ThirtySpace hero section page (src/pages/ThirtySpaceHero.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch thirtyspace_hero_section to React. Hero section: headline, subheadline, CTA buttons, background image. Neubrutalism: bold typography, high-contrast colors, sharp edges. Static content. CTA buttons link to other pages.
acceptance_criteria: CTA buttons navigate to correct pages

tickets.title: Build ThirtySpace login/register page (src/pages/ThirtySpaceAuth.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch thirtyspace_login_register_mobile to React. Auth form: login/register tabs, email, password, submit button. Neubrutalism styling: thick borders, bright colors, no rounded corners. Form validation: required fields, email format. Mock submission: log form data to console.
acceptance_criteria: Submit log form data to console

tickets.title: Build ThirtySpace 404 page (src/pages/ThirtySpace404.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch thirtyspace_404_navigation_bento_variant to React. 404 page: error message, navigation links, bento layout. Neubrutalism: bold typography, high-contrast colors, sharp edges. Navigation links to key pages.

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Navigation bar: links to all pages. React Router: route setup for all pages. Neubrutalism styling: consistent across app. Responsive: mobile nav toggle, desktop nav bar. Error boundary: catch rendering errors, show user-friendly message.
